problem.cause: Mutation setup required an unfinished live causal reread. After Nevada completion none remained, so setup threw even though production F35 passed.

implementation: Extracted the existing production F31/F35 block into checkClaimHistoryAndPostRepairRereads; block bytes match the original after only ROOT-to-root parameter substitution. Live run calls it in the same check order.

Retained both existing live F35 mutations when an actual causal subject exists. With no subject, execute the existing production checks and repair reader against a tiny isolated Git history instead. There is no live-data substitute and no skip of F35.

Fallback requires a passing baseline, refusal when its sole exact repair completion is revoked, and refusal when both selected/substantive verdict bases advance to committed repaired HEAD. F31 must stay green in every case. Actual F31/F35 output and child exit code are required; an exception cannot stand in for a detected refusal.
Each negative control is followed by restoring the original bytes and requiring the positive baseline again; Git checks fixture restoration and finally removes only this generated temporary fixture.
